windows.why: Restored from the burst, but NOT to the old $150 — that was set when a night cost $96 per 5h, and it would now throttle one. With `questions` finished, windows runs flat out: the busiest 5h of the 2026-09-18/19 burst cost $155.71. $250 clears a full night with room, and still stops a runaway.
A week of full nights at ~$200 is ~$1,400, so the old $1,000 would have cut two nights off every week. This is a guard against a loop, not a throttle.

note: Nightly values, restored 2026-09-19 after the burst. These are now a RUNAWAY GUARD rather than a daytime reserve: the burst ran 14.2h continuously at 2 workers without ever reaching the subscription's cap, so the pipeline cannot take the whole window even if allowed to. The only way to lose throughput now is to set these too low.
